images.title: Courtyard to the Altar
images.story: Stepping out above the grand esplanade, the symmetry is almost startling between these sheer limestone cliffs. Two low-slung, covered colonnades guide the eye straight toward the stepped stone altar on the valley floor. The early afternoon heat was climbing, but the open pavement was still blissfully clear of crowds.

images.title: Green Basin Under Karst
images.story: Around the bend, the valley opens into a wide basin of still, emerald-tinted water ringed by steep forest. A dirt path curves quietly along the shoreline, dotted with saplings catching the pale afternoon sun. You could stand here for ten minutes and hear little more than dragonflies and the occasional breeze skimming the surface.

images.title: Gates of Điện Kính Thiên
images.story: The main gatehouse of Điện Kính Thiên stands wedged directly between two dark karst walls, looking like a fortress from another dynasty. Gold-inscribed characters gleam above the central arch, while small ceremonial pennants flutter along the stone balustrade. Framed this straight-on, the dark rooflines feel pinned against the pale sky by sheer rock.

images.title: Three Arches on Still Water
images.story: The three-arched stone bridge cuts a clean curve across the water at the base of a towering limestone wall. Late afternoon sun warmed the pale masonry, casting soft, rounded reflections across the green surface. A small wooden punt sat moored in the shadows by the near bank, waiting for rowers who were nowhere in sight.

images.title: Rowing Past the Fleet
images.story: Dozens of metal sampans sat tied up side-by-side along the bank, their red flags and folded canopies neatly parked under the trees. Out in the channel, a small boatload of visitors in bright orange vests cut a slow ripple through the dark water. The sheer wall of tangled jungle behind them made the boats look like toy models adrift on green glass.

images.title: Quiet Stroke on Green Water
images.story: A single boat glided across the middle of the lake, oars dipping in slow unison against the silence of the valley. With the sun dropping behind the limestone ridge, the water turned a rich, shadowy bottle green. The line of docked sampans in the background stayed motionless, waiting for the weekend rush that had not arrived yet.
